title: Command acknowledged
description: Sent for any incoming message that carried a message_id. Acknowledgment means the command was accepted, not that its effect is already visible: plugins.on() dispatch is asynchronous and service restarts take time.

acknowledged.description: The `type` of the message being acknowledged.

timestamp.description: Epoch seconds at which the plugin produced the message.

message_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. When present the plugin echoes it in the reply and in the acknowledgment.
